words.definition: A sign that shows you may be ill.
words.example: Fever is a common symptom of flu.
words.example_id: Demam adalah gejala flu yang umum.

words.definition: To become healthy again after illness.
words.example: She recovered quickly after the surgery.
words.example_id: Dia pulih dengan cepat setelah operasi.

words.definition: A doctor's written order for medicine.
words.example: You need a prescription for this antibiotic.
words.example_id: Kamu perlu resep untuk antibiotik ini.

words.definition: An arranged time to meet a doctor or professional.
words.example: I booked an appointment with the dentist.
words.example_id: Saya membuat janji temu dengan dokter gigi.

words.example: Vaccines help the body become immune.
He suffered a knee injury while running.
words.example_id: Dia mengalami cedera lutut saat berlari.

words.definition: Containing substances that keep you healthy.
A shop where medicines are sold.
words.example: The pharmacy is open until nine.

words.definition: A feeling of being extremely tired.
To take air into your lungs and let it out.
words.example: Try to breathe slowly and relax.
